p0.descriptionHtml:
The Grand Luxury Bed is a premium oversized upholstered bed frame, designed for large bedrooms that can accommodate a bed of significant presence. A tall, deeply padded headboard brings real luxury to the space, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Grand oversized premium headboard
  • Deeply padded luxury fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes and prices

Small Double (4FT) £519.99; Double (4FT6) £558.99; King (5FT) £597.99; Super King (6FT) £636.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is the Grand Luxury Bed right for a small room?

It is an oversized bed designed for large bedrooms, so please check your room dimensions carefully before ordering. Call 07417 439197 if you would like advice.

Which sizes is it available in?

Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). It is not listed in Single (3FT).

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

See also: upholstered beds.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Grand Princess Luxury Bed is a tall upholstered bed frame with a grand, oversized headboard, one of the most impressive beds in the Eagle Bed range. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden slatted base, from £454.99 in Single 3ft to £623.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Grand oversized luxury headboard
  • Deeply padded premium upholstered headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £454.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £493.99
  • Double 4ft6: £519.99
  • King 5ft: £558.99
  • Super King 6ft: £623.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Mattress compatibility

This is a bed frame with no built-in storage, on a slatted base that suits standard UK mattresses. Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99) or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99). This is a larger-than-standard design, so check your room dimensions before ordering.

Customisation

A bed this size shows off the fabric, so order free swatches first. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the Princess Luxury Bed, browse upholstered beds, and check the space first with our guide to measuring your bedroom.

FAQ

How big is the Grand Princess headboard?

It is a tall, oversized headboard and the bed is larger than standard, so please measure your room and ceiling height before ordering. Call us if you want advice.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £454.99, Small Double 4ft £493.99, Double 4ft6 £519.99, King 5ft £558.99, Super King 6ft £623.99.

What is the difference from the Princess Luxury Bed?

Both are tall statement beds handmade in Dewsbury. The Grand Princess is described as the more opulent, oversized design; compare the two and the prices above, or call us for advice.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Hampton Panel Bed brings the vertical panel look in a shorter headboard height than Aurora or Monarch. It is aimed at buyers who want the panel style on a tighter budget, and the lower profile suits smaller rooms. Each bed is handcrafted in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Vertical panel headboard, shorter than the Aurora range
  • Matching footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Wooden frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £312.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £339.99; King (5FT) £351.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen and Crushed Velvet. Choose from a wide range of colours. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How tall is the Hampton headboard compared with the Aurora?

The Hampton headboard is shorter than Aurora or Monarch. For a taller option see the Aurora Vertical Panel Bed or the Grand Extra-Tall Panel Bed.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call 07417 439197 to confirm the options for this design.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Harrow Button Panel Headboard is for period and modern bedrooms alike. Deep button detailing across a padded panel gives it a traditional, luxurious feel, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Classic button-panel design with deep button detailing
  • Comfortable padded panel to lean against
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Five UK sizes, with made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Can I fit the Harrow headboard to a divan base?

Yes. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base.

Is it made to measure?

Made-to-measure options are available on request. Call 07417 439197 or email us to discuss.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
